rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose rendering for an associated group, including friends or a work crew such as 一班工人.

example.english: I went out to eat with a gang of friends.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 jat1 baan1 jan4 heoi3 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this for a criminal gang, especially an established or organized underworld group.

example.english: That gang controls a lot of territory in the district.
example.traditional: 嗰個黑幫喺區內控制咗好多地盤。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 hak1 bong1 hai2 keoi1 noi6 hung3 zai3 zo2 hou2 do1 dei6 pun4

rows.note: Use this for a street-based gang or faction, while 黑幫 more strongly suggests an organized criminal underworld group.

example.english: One gang is fighting another over territory in the streets.
example.traditional: 一個幫派喺街頭同另一個爭地盤。
example.jyutping: jat1 go3 bong1 paai3 hai2 gaai1 tau4 tung4 ling6 jat1 go3 zaang1 dei6 pun4
